newsitem.title: CANADA: Thunder Bay vessel clearances - May 12.
newsitem.headline: Thunder Bay vessel clearances - May 12.

text.p: Daily vessel loading/clearances at Thunder Bay, Ontario:
May 8 Canadian Provider 25,000 wht Loading Stl Ports
May 8 Algontario 26,000 wht Loading Stl Ports
May 9 Ziemia Tarnowksa 18,000 wht Waiting Foreign
May 9 Canadian Trader 26,000 -- Waiting Stl Ports
May 10 El Kef 20,000 wht Due 5/10 Foreign
May 13 Pomorzie Zachodnie 9,000 wht Due 5/13 Foreign Prt
May 13 Federal Saguenay 18,500 wht Due 5/13 Foreign
May 14 Canadian Ranger 16,000 unk/dom Due 5/14 Foreign
May 16 Mantadoc 16,000 dom Due 5/16 Bay Ports
NOTE: Thunder Bay reopened April 1 when H.M. Griffith cleared. Source: Lake Shippers Clearance Assn.
Note wht=wheat, can=canola, m/wht=milling wheat, dom=domestic milling wheat, M=meal, P=pellets, O=oil. Ready=preparing to load. MT=metric tonne. Stl Ports=St Lawrence Ports. Wind=Windsor.
